message.from_name: Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
message.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
message.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hi guys, thanks for the email - yeah, delivery was a bit messy last year but we're on it now. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We also checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Let's make this work, we value the business but we need a fair price to keep the machines running.

Our offer is a price of €47.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, I can drop the price to 46.50 EUR and give you 800 ppm, which is a big step up from our side, paired with a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. With overtime we can deliver in 56 days, at a premium.

Quality: We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached.
